1 & 2. SDG Output and Outcome Framework Report 2022-23 and SDG Budget Allocation Report 2022-23 developed, published and disseminated to government stakeholders. Consultation meetings conducted with all 53 departments to streamline outputs-outcomes and physical targets of their schemes 3. Good Practice Case Study on Saksham Yuva , a scheme for Empowering the Educated Unemployed Youth with Allowance & Honorary Work in Haryana has been completed after incorporating inputs from all stakeholders. 4. Strategic Action Plan on Education, Skills & Employment completed. By using SDGs framework, the document presents analysis of challenges and opportunities related to Education, Skilling, and Employment for Haryana in a national and global policy setting. 5. Study on Gender Sensitive Budgeting in Haryana has not been approved by the Government 6. SDG Urban Indicator Framework/City Index document has been submitted to the Govt for feedback 7. The SDG Aligned Integrated District Plan in work in progress 8. Operationalization of Aatmanirbhar Bharat Tracker has not yet been approved by the Govt. Activity will be initiated once requisite approvals/funding is in place 9. Gram Panchayat named Rehore, Block Barwala of District Panchkula has been identified to roll out pilot to promote SDG Localization at grass root level. Field visit and discussions have been held in this Gram Panchayat with Govt functionaries. 10. SDG Localization manual in local language-Hind has been drafted. This document would serve as a capacity building tool and could be used as a resource material during various district and block level training programmes 11. Annual Report on Haryana SDG Index-This report is based on Niti Aayog’s SDG India Index and Dashboard which has not yet been released by Niti Aayog for 2022.The report will be prepared once Niti Aayog releases its report in the coming months 12. The first version of District Ranking and Indicator progress derived from State and District Indicator Framework of Haryana was released as Provisional on 05 October, 2021 by Hon’ble Chief Minister Haryana and Advisor NITI Aayog, Government of India. The second and current edition was released on 29 July, 2022 by Hon’ble Chief Minister Haryana and Resident Representative UNDP India in presence of Haryana cabinet 13. Two Organizations (Indian Railway Finance Corporation Ltd (IIRFC) and Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) have given in-principle sanction for funding for issuance of Bond 14. Activity has not yet been approved by the Government.

1. Organize SDGCC awareness conclaves for legislators, administrative secretaries and Heads of Departments 2. Generate awareness around SDGs through IEC and communications outreach (films, booklets and other collateral) 3. Create digital presence of SDGs in Haryana 4. Finalize State Indicator Framework 5. Document good practices case study 6. Draft annual Output-Outcome report and SDG Budget Allocation report 2020-21 7. Draft SDG District profile booklets 8. Finalize reports on SDGs landscape in private sector and NGO space

1. Exhibition on SDGs conducted to sensitize legislators, heads of departments and other government officials 2. A short film to sensitize legislators about SDGs developed for the exhibition and several posters and videos created for dissemination on social media 3. Digital presence of SDGs established through regular social media posts, campaigns (#humans4sdgs), multi level online quizzes for students, NGOs and government officials 4. State Indicator Framework for Haryana has been finalized 5. 6 case studies to showcase good practices documented on topics such as affordable and clean energy, education, governance and healthcare 6. SDG Output and Outcome Framework Report and SDG Budget Allocation report developed, published and disseminated to government stakeholders 7. District SDG profile booklets completed for 20 districts of the state. These booklets will serve as useful resources to support district level planning, implementation and monitoring 8. 3 reports on SDG linkages with private sector, NGOs and universities created

1. Draft SDG related Annual Budgetary Reports for the Government of Haryana 2. Document 2 good practice case studies 3. Develop Mid-term (2025) action plan for Haryana 4. Draft report on SDG Haryana Index with district-wise rankings 5. Draft SDG District Indicator Framework (DIF) 6. Finalize SDG Localization Manual (SDG Online Learning Material in Hindi) 7. Develop Output- Outcome Framework of Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) 8. Develop E-module to build capacity at all levels of governance about Sustainable Development (SD) and SDGs 9. Create awareness around SDGs through creation of films, booklets and other collaterals 10. Further Enhance SDG Digital Presence 11. Engage with private sector by organizing SDG Hackathons and Business Association Roundtable Discussions

RESULTS 2021
1. SDG Output and Outcome Framework Report 2021-22 and SDG Budget Allocation Report 2021-22 developed, published and disseminated to government stakeholders. Consultation meetings conducted with all 53 departments to streamline outputs-outcomes and physical targets of their schemes. Debt Utilization and Achievements Report 2021 finalized to help identify the factors of increasing Debt liability in Haryana and explore the outcomes of loans as an investment for capital expenditure in development works.
2.9 Good case practice studies have already been documented and highlight not only achievements of various schemes but also the key challenges. One more case study on ‘Saksham Yuva’ programme of the Haryana Gov.t is currently under process.
3.To be initiated, Government approval and funding awaited
4 & 5.State Indicator Framework and District Indicator Framework for Haryana have been drafted through a consultative approach involving all stakeholders. The Haryana SDG State Index Report 2021 and Provisional SDG District Index Report 2021 were finalized and launched by the Honourable Chief Minister of Haryana in October 2021.
6.SDG Localization manual draft (in local language, hindi) has been prepared
7,8. To be initiated, Government approval and funding awaited
9. 3 short films created, and 1 workshop conducted to generate awareness around SDGs
10. To be initiated, Government approval and funding awaited
11.Work on SDG Green Bond has been initiated with regular inputs and discussions with the State government.
